--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
/-- Guessing rule for the `bound` tactic: when trying to prove `x ^ y ≤ x ^ z`, we can either assume
`1 ≤ x` or `0 < x ≤ 1`. -/
@[bound] lemma rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le_or_ge {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : 1 ≤ x ∧ y ≤ z ∨ 0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1 ∧ z ≤ y) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z := by
  rcases h with ⟨x1, yz⟩ | ⟨x0, x1, zy⟩
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le x1 yz
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge x0 x1 zy

@[improver_example inlining, version unoptimized]
theorem foo {x y : ℝ} : x ≤ y ∧ ¬y ≤ x ↔ x ≤ y ∧ x ≠ y := by
  /-
    x y : Real
    ⊢ Iff (And (LE.le x y) (Not (LE.le y x))) (And (LE.le x y) (Ne x y))
  -/
  constructor
    /-
      case mp
      x y : Real
      ⊢ And (LE.le x y) (Not (LE.le y x)) → And (LE.le x y) (Ne x y)
    -/
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
    /-
      case mp.intro
      x y : Real
      h0 : LE.le x y
      h1 : Not (LE.le y x)
      ⊢ And (LE.le x y) (Ne x y)
    -/
    constructor
      /-
        case mp.intro.left
        x y : Real
        h0 : LE.le x y
        h1 : Not (LE.le y x)
        ⊢ LE.le x y
      -/
    · exact h0
      /-
        🎉 no goals
      -/
    /-
      case mp.intro.right
      x y : Real
      h0 : LE.le x y
      h1 : Not (LE.le y x)
      ⊢ Ne x y
    -/
    intro h2
    /-
      case mp.intro.right
      x y : Real
      h0 : LE.le x y
      h1 : Not (LE.le y x)
      h2 : Eq x y
      ⊢ False
    -/
    apply h1
    /-
      case mp.intro.right
      x y : Real
      h0 : LE.le x y
      h1 : Not (LE.le y x)
      h2 : Eq x y
      ⊢ LE.le y x
    -/
    rw [h2]
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
  /-
    case mpr
    x y : Real
    ⊢ And (LE.le x y) (Ne x y) → And (LE.le x y) (Not (LE.le y x))
  -/
  rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
  /-
    case mpr.intro
    x y : Real
    h0 : LE.le x y
    h1 : Ne x y
    ⊢ And (LE.le x y) (Not (LE.le y x))
  -/
  constructor
    /-
      case mpr.intro.left
      x y : Real
      h0 : LE.le x y
      h1 : Ne x y
      ⊢ LE.le x y
    -/
  · exact h0
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
  /-
    case mpr.intro.right
    x y : Real
    h0 : LE.le x y
    h1 : Ne x y
    ⊢ Not (LE.le y x)
  -/
  intro h2
  /-
    case mpr.intro.right
    x y : Real
    h0 : LE.le x y
    h1 : Ne x y
    h2 : LE.le y x
    ⊢ False
  -/
  apply h1
  /-
    case mpr.intro.right
    x y : Real
    h0 : LE.le x y
    h1 : Ne x y
    h2 : LE.le y x
    ⊢ Eq x y
  -/
  apply le_antisymm h0 h2
  /-
    🎉 no goals
  -/

theorem injective_iff_hasLeftInverse : Injective f ↔ HasLeftInverse f :=
  ⟨Injective.hasLeftInverse, HasLeftInverse.injective⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Defs
theorem HasLeftInverse.injective {f : α → β} : HasLeftInverse f → Injective f := fun h =>
  Exists.elim h fun _finv inv => inv.injective

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
theorem leftInverse_iff_comp {f : α → β} {g : β → α} : LeftInverse f g ↔ f ∘ g = id :=
  ⟨LeftInverse.comp_eq_id, congr_fun⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
theorem leftInverse_invFun (hf : Injective f) : LeftInverse (invFun f) f :=
  fun b ↦ hf <| invFun_eq ⟨b, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
theorem bijective_iff_has_inverse : Bijective f ↔ ∃ g, LeftInverse g f ∧ RightInverse g f :=
  ⟨fun hf ↦ ⟨_, leftInverse_surjInv hf, rightInverse_surjInv hf.2⟩, fun ⟨_, gl, gr⟩ ↦
    ⟨gl.injective, gr.surjective⟩⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
theorem leftInverse_iff {g : α → α} :
    g.LeftInverse f ↔ g = f :=
  ⟨fun hg ↦ funext fun x ↦ by rw [← h x, hg, h], fun he ↦ he ▸ h.leftInverse⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
theorem surjective_iff_hasRightInverse : Surjective f ↔ HasRightInverse f :=
  ⟨Surjective.hasRightInverse, HasRightInverse.surjective⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
@[simp]
theorem Injective.of_comp_iff (hf : Injective f) (g : γ → α) :
    Injective (f ∘ g) ↔ Injective g :=
  ⟨Injective.of_comp, hf.comp⟩

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Defs
theorem rightInverse_of_injective_of_leftInverse {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (injf : Injective f)
    (lfg : LeftInverse f g) : RightInverse f g := fun x =>
  have h : f (g (f x)) = f x := lfg (f x)
  injf h

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Function.Defs
protected theorem LeftInverse.id {g : β → α} {f : α → β} (h : LeftInverse g f) : g ∘ f = id :=
  funext h

@[improver_example inlining2, version unoptimized]
theorem bar : Injective f ↔ LeftInverse (inverse f) f := by
  /-
    α : Type u_1

    inst✝ : Inhabited α
    f : α → β
    ⊢ Iff (Function.Injective f) (Function.LeftInverse (inverse f) f)
  -/
  constructor
    /-
      case mp
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      inst✝ : Inhabited α
      f : α → β
      ⊢ Function.Injective f → Function.LeftInverse (inverse f) f
    -/
  · intro h y
    /-
      case mp
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      inst✝ : Inhabited α
      f : α → β
      h : Function.Injective f
      y : α
      ⊢ Eq (inverse f (f y)) y
    -/
    apply h
    /-
      case mp.a
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      inst✝ : Inhabited α
      f : α → β
      h : Function.Injective f
      y : α
      ⊢ Eq (f (inverse f (f y))) (f y)
    -/
    apply inverse_spec
    /-
      case mp.a.h
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      inst✝ : Inhabited α
      f : α → β
      h : Function.Injective f
      y : α
      ⊢ Exists fun x => Eq (f x) (f y)
    -/
    use y
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
  /-
    case mpr
    α : Type u_1
    β : Type u_2
    inst✝ : Inhabited α
    f : α → β
    ⊢ Function.LeftInverse (inverse f) f → Function.Injective f
  -/
  intro h x1 x2 e
  /-
    case mpr
    α : Type u_1
    β : Type u_2
    inst✝ : Inhabited α
    f : α → β
    h : Function.LeftInverse (inverse f) f
    x1 x2 : α
    e : Eq (f x1) (f x2)
    ⊢ Eq x1 x2
  -/
  rw [← h x1, ← h x2, e]
  /-
    🎉 no goals
  -/
